title: UK ETS aviation emissions-monitoring-plan application QA controls

sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for aviation: how to comply

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS

facts.source_fact: UK ETS compliance begins when an entity becomes an aircraft operator in scope.
facts.expected_handling: Bind obligations to confirmed aircraft-operator status.

facts.source_fact: A potential aircraft operator should contact its regulator when obligations may apply.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer regulator status from flight data alone.

facts.source_fact: An emissions monitoring plan application is due within 42 days of becoming an aircraft operator.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the 42-day trigger and operator-status date.

facts.source_fact: Aircraft operators are assigned one of four regulators according to registered office or residence.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve jurisdiction before routing compliance actions.

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency regulates operators based in England and operators based outside the UK.
The regulator issues the emissions monitoring plan after approving the application.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat an application as an issued EMP.

facts.source_fact: The issued EMP specifies how aviation emissions must be monitored and reported.
facts.expected_handling: Bind monitoring methods to the approved EMP.

facts.source_fact: Aircraft operators must comply with the conditions of the issued EMP.
EMP applications and related reporting are managed through the UK ETS reporting service METS.
An EMP is an operator compliance document, not a measured parcel-level emissions value.
facts.expected_handling: Never convert EMP status into parcel emissions.

guard_patterns.handling: Require official-source provenance for each fact.
Apply only after aircraft-operator status is established.
Keep deadline trigger and date together.
Do not infer parcel emissions from operator compliance.
Flag unresolved status, jurisdiction or deadline conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
